name: Amalia Cynthia Semira Kali van Nite
source:
Amalia is the legitimate heiress to the throne. Her mother died when she was still a child and the king vanished a long time ago. Therefore, she is just a princess and can only be crowned queen on her 18th birthday. Nonetheless, she is in control of the kingdom and harasses her subjects. Obsessed with gold and jewels, she soon realizes that everything is not enough for her. She is tired of her boring existence in the palace, but then she has an idea: The winter is pretty tough and the princess calls for a new pelt. Of course this must not be an ordinary one. It has to be the one of a very rare animal…

Amalia may look nice, but deep inside she is evil and ruthless. The power over everything and everybody has spoiled her; she does not care about her fellow humans at all. What might happen when she meets Elenor?
